decisions.question: How do client-specified colors/fonts in the approved PRD interact with downstream design-system defaults (shadcn/SEED/Wanted at stage 4-2)?
decisions.effect: The research package carries prd.brandConstraints verbatim as package.brandConstraints (source approved-prd, precedence client_values_override_design_system_defaults, unspecified properties -> selected system defaults). Reference distillation's 'style' direction must recommend within these constraints and never propose replacing them; visualPreference notes remain advisory. Structural component/layout contracts of the design systems are retained. Ambiguity, unavailable fonts, or readability/contrast failures are surfaced to the client in the owning session, never silently substituted.
